we present the first authenticated data stream outsourcing solution that provides lightweight authentication and immediate authentication of data stream freshness.

we present a novel construct, IncBM- Tree, that provides immediate authentication of data stream freshness in the presence of real-time and historical accesses, with low computational overheads and memory footprints, and high throughput.
we propose a lightweight authentication scheme for data freshness in outsourced multi-version key-value stores.

the problem of authenticating data freshness in the context of outsourced data stores.
the design of lightweight authentication schemes that can be used by data owners to verify the freshness of their data in outsourced keyvalue stores.
the design of lightweight authentication of freshness in the context of multi-version data outsourcing.

the proposed IncBM-Tree construct is a practical solution that can be deployed in the context of data-intensive applications to authenticate the freshness and integrity of outsourced data.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we propose a new data structure to authenticate the freshness in outsourced multi-version key-value stores, where data owners can outsource data to untrusted cloud servers and data users can verify the authenticity of data freshness in the outsourced data stores.

we propose a novel construct that provides lightweight authentication of freshness of outsourced key-value data, and we show that the proposed construct can outperform state-of-the-art work by an order of magnitude in performance.

we provide the first practical authenticated data outsourcing solution that supports immediate freshness and authenticity for massive data streams, while requiring lightweight computation for data owners and end-users.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed IncBM-Tree is a lightweight solution to provide immediate authentication of freshness for outsourced multi-version key-value stores.

the proposed solution can provide immediate data authenticity and freshness to end users with a small amount of CPU usage and a small amount of memory footprint, and thus can be deployed in a practical setting.
it is possible to achieve data authenticity and freshness in outsourced data streams without compromising the performance of the data outsourcing service.
